coverage.note: 1977-01-05 to 1977-12-21. Appeal numbers are plain 4-digit numbers (e.g. 7703) with V-prefixed variance appeals (e.g. V-7726). The OCR double-spaces nearly every word and is heavily garbled in places, especially November-December; quotes are verbatim OCR, errors included. Conflicts recorded as printed, never reconciled: the same appeal number is used for different appeals (7703, 7746, 7760, 7801, 7803, 7852, 7898, 7966, 7993, 8052, 8060, 7939, and 7731, which is also the number printed for the first Golden Gate and Van Ness protest appeal, identified as 7781 from the April 20 rehearing requests, the second being 7782); Appeal 7782 was denied a rehearing twice at the April 20 meeting, once for lack of a motion and once by a motion failing to receive four affirmative votes; Appeal 8034 is stated to have been continued to December 14 and was also heard and decided on November 30; the October 26 minutes are headed October 26 but the body text says the meeting was held November 2, and are recorded as October 26; the July 6 minutes are headed July 6 but the body says Wednesday, July 5, and are recorded as July 6 (July 6, 1977 was a Wednesday); the April 6 further hearing is printed as Appeal 7768 but is the 7788 waste-fitting appeal; the May 18 further hearing is printed as Appeal 7822 but is the 7833 appeal; the October 5 further hearing is printed as Appeal 7938 but is the appeal at 330 Grove Street; the denial date in Appeal 7849 is printed as 6/27/77; addresses read from garbled OCR include 1015 Poison Street, 737 Island Avenue, and 180 Buchanan Street. Skipped entirely: peddler, pushcart, taxicab, jitney, mobile-caterer, loudspeaker-vehicle and driver-vehicle appeals; appeals with no building address or an unreadable address; and appeals about permits revoked or denied because of alleged criminal conduct.
